name: llama.cpp
one_liner: A free, highly optimized engine that lets AI language models run directly on ordinary computers — even without a fancy GPU — instead of needing an expensive cloud service.
buyer: A product company wanting to embed private, offline AI chat features into their app without paying per-token cloud API fees.
business_use_cases: An app developer embeds it to offer offline, on-device AI chat features in a privacy-focused product, avoiding ongoing API costs.
A hardware vendor bundles it to market AI-capable laptops or mini-PCs that run chatbots without an internet connection.
An IT consultant sets up on-premise AI chat servers for businesses, like law firms or clinics, that can't send data to the cloud for compliance reasons.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a turnkey 'private, on-premise AI server' appliance (hardware plus llama.cpp plus a model) to compliance-sensitive businesses
Offer managed on-prem AI deployment and support retainers for companies that need their own infrastructure

steal_this: Build and sell a 'compliance-friendly local AI assistant' box for law firms or clinics who need AI chat but can't send client data to the cloud.
